description: The texts a relayed deposit's funder and a relayed merge's owner sign, raw Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes. The target is the ring 0x06 repeated behind the service 0x02 on the cluster 0x01. deposit.proofInputs is relay_proof_inputs.json on the deposit rail with no plan, one dummy input of blinding 0x1d in tree 4 and one SOL deposit leg of 1000000 lamports from the funder, the Ed25519 keypair of seed 0x08 repeated. The merge request carries the proofInputs of relay_merge_inputs.json and its owner is the Ed25519 keypair of seed 0x05 repeated. Each request line is the base58 SHA-256 of the domain and proofInputs. Each signature is the signer's over the message. Pinned by the sdk-libs/client rpc tests and the TypeScript relayRequestAttestation test.
